title: pipeline/formats/<format>/format.json (BUILD_SPEC.md 14.7, M20): the stages of a format in order, its sessions, caps and reopen routes, its config block, the review rubric, the required channel files and the template folder

session_groups.description: model sessions shared by several stages: the group name maps to the stages that continue one session

id.description: the stage key: also the name of the run's subfolder

folder.description: the stage folder when it differs from the id (the format's own stages/ first, then pipeline/stages/)

label.description: the short name in status lines (S13)

activity.description: the default activity text of the status line

output.description: the primary output file of the stage (the stage is done when it validates)

session.description: the session group the stage belongs to

model_role.description: the main models role of the stage (documentation; ai() takes the role from the call)

caps.description: the config caps keys the stage reads

reopen.description: the stages this stage may reopen through reopen.txt (the gate, the angle loop, the review)

prompts.description: prompt overrides: name to a file under the format folder

rubric.description: the review rubric file under the format folder

required_files.description: preflight entries (the shape of config preflight.require) for the files a channel of this format must have; a missing one is a systemic stop for that channel only

template.description: the folder under the format folder that new-channel copies

config.description: the format's block of the resolved config (BUILD_SPEC.md 14.4)

builder.description: composition: the timeline stage describes the HyperFrames composition; cut: a stage of the format writes timeline.json itself
